load_rednet_model: load a RedNet model from a checkpoint file for RGB-D semantic segmentation
run_rednet_inference: run the RedNetResizeWrapper forward pass on RGB and depth tensors to get semantic predictions
create_rednet_wrapper: create a RedNetResizeWrapper with configurable resize, stabilize, and num_classes options
review_rednet_forward_downsample: review the RedNet forward_downsample method that fuses RGB and depth features through dual ResNet branches
review_rednet_forward_upsample: review the RedNet forward_upsample method that upsamples fused features with auxiliary outputs during training
